understanding.goal_understanding: Reach the + goal gem by navigating horizontally through the tile grid and allowing gravity to carry the character through successive sections.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: MOVE_LEFT and MOVE_RIGHT shift the character horizontally, after which it automatically falls in the current gravity direction until landing on support, hitting a hazard, or reaching the goal. Gravity was DOWN in this episode. CLICK targets a clickable tile such as x and removes it without moving the player or advancing the rising-platform timer; this can open a fall path. Spikes cause immediate failure, safe tiles support landing, and UNDO reverts the previous action.
